=== Quickstart ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Quickstart                                                                                                  │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Action preview                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Command preview: Quickstart: first setup          │
                                                           │                                                    │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  Command:                                          │
 │                                                    │    │    linux-maint init --minimal                      │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │  Risk:                                             │
 │  - Use the bootstrap wizard to create config,      │    │    Changes system                                  │
 │  validate readiness, and preview the first run     │    │                                                    │
 │  - Current incident is best after you already      │    │  Reads:                                            │
 │  have a summary or active failure                  │    │  - starter templates from the repo/install         │
 │  - Escalation is most useful once report, JSON,    │    │  template directory                                │
 │  or bundle artifacts exist                         │    │  - current target config root                      │
 │                                                    │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │                                                    │
                                                           │  Writes:                                           │
                                                           │  - starter config files under                      │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │
                                                           │  - may overwrite existing templates only when --   │
                                                           │  force is set                                      │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Likely next step:                                 │
                                                           │    Edit inventory, then run check and run --plan   │
                                                           │  before the first live execution.                  │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  first_setup       Guide: first setup and safe first run [f]
  current_incident  Guide: current incident triage [i]
  escalation        Guide: export and escalation workflow [e]
  inventory         Edit: servers.txt inventory [s]
  groups            Open: hosts.d groups overview [g]
  docs              Open: setup docs [d]
  back              Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, . previews, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Overview ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Overview                                                                                                    │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Action preview                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Opens the live dashboard view.                    │
                                                           │                                                    │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  Reads:                                            │
 │                                                    │    │  - latest status/report artifacts from             │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/logs   │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │                                                    │
 │  - Dashboard for the live operations view          │    │  Writes:                                           │
 │  - Problems for the latest non-OK rows             │    │  - none                                            │
 │  - Report when you need a short operator summary   │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Likely next step:                                 │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │    Jump to problems or report if you need a        │
                                                           │  narrower answer.                                  │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  dashboard   Open: live operations dashboard [d]
  status      Open: current status snapshot [s]
  problems    Review: latest non-OK rows [p]
  report      Review: short operator summary [r]
  trend       Analyze: recent trend (last 10 runs) [t]
  back        Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, . previews, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Run checks ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Run checks                                                                                                  │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Action preview                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Command preview: linux-maint run                  │
                                                           │                                                    │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  Command:                                          │
 │                                                    │    │    linux-maint run                                 │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │  Risk:                                             │
 │  - Before a live run, create or review config in   │    │    Changes system                                  │
 │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │    │                                                    │
 │  - Add targets in                                  │    │  Reads:                                            │
 │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/servers.txt or       │    │  - config from /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture        │
 │  under /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/hosts.d        │    │  - inventory from                                  │
 │  - Use plan once the inventory is ready            │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/servers.txt and      │
 │                                                    │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/hosts.d              │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  - monitor scripts and current policy settings     │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Writes:                                           │
                                                           │  - run artifacts under                             │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/logs   │
                                                           │  - history/index state under                       │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture                    │
                                                           │  - optional audit records when enabled             │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Likely next step:                                 │
                                                           │    Use Overview or Export next to review the       │
                                                           │  result and capture any follow-up artifacts.       │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  run       Execute: run checks now (live output) [r] [changes]
  plan      Preview: resolved run plan only [p]
  wizard    Guide: guided run setup wizard [w]
  back      Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, . previews, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Investigate ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Investigate                                                                                                 │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Action preview                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Opens filtered status drilldown with host,        │
                                                           │  monitor, reason, and status filters.              │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Reads:                                            │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │  - status JSON snapshot from                       │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/logs   │
 │  - Investigate needs either a summary, a log, or   │    │                                                    │
 │  history artifacts                                 │    │  Writes:                                           │
 │  - summary=yes  logs=no  history=no                │    │  - none                                            │
 │  - Run check and a safe plan first, then come      │    │                                                    │
 │  back for drilldown                                │    │  Likely next step:                                 │
 │                                                    │    │    Narrow to one host or monitor, then explain     │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  the top reason or monitor.                        │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  drilldown   Analyze: filtered status drilldown [d]
  diff        Inspect: changes since previous run [f]
  history     Inspect: recent run history [h]
  logs        Inspect: latest wrapper log [l]
  reasons     Review: top reason tokens [r]
  runtimes    Analyze: slowest monitors [u]
  back        Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, . previews, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Repair ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Repair                                                                                                      │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Action preview                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Opens guided incident response based on the       │
                                                           │  latest top reason and monitor.                    │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Reads:                                            │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │  - summary, reasons, problems, and logs            │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │                                                    │
 │  Current triage: connectivity triage: reason       │    │  Writes:                                           │
 │  explain + focused status + network rerun          │    │  - none until you choose a follow-up action        │
 │  - Doctor validates deeper dependencies and fixes  │    │                                                    │
 │  - Check confirms readiness before the next full   │    │  Likely next step:                                 │
 │  run                                               │    │    Use this when you want the fastest recommended  │
 │                                                    │    │  recovery path.                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  incident      Guide: incident response workflow [i]
  focused_run   Execute: focused service and network checks [f]
  check         Validate: config and readiness checks [c]
  doctor        Diagnose: doctor checks and fixes [d] [changes]
  selfcheck     Validate: self-check (safe) [s]
  secprofile    Inspect: strict security profile [p]
  back          Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, . previews, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Export ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Export                                                                                                      │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Action preview                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Command preview: linux-maint report --short --    │
                                                           │  no-trend                                          │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Command:                                          │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │    linux-maint report --short --no-trend           │
 │  Recommended first action: report                  │    │                                                    │
 │  - Report for people, export JSON for systems      │    │  Risk:                                             │
 │  - Metrics and runtimes for dashboards and tuning  │    │    Read-only                                       │
 │  - Pack logs when you need a support bundle        │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Reads:                                            │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  - latest artifacts under                          │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/logs   │
                                                           │  - history state under                             │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture when needed        │
                                                           │  - current config root for hints and metadata      │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Writes:                                           │
                                                           │  - read-only output to the terminal unless --      │
                                                           │  output is used                                    │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Likely next step:                                 │
                                                           │    If you see failures, move to Investigate or     │
                                                           │  Repair for drilldown and remediation.             │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  report        Open: short report summary [r]
  trend         Open: recent trend (last 10 runs) [t]
  runtimes      Open: runtime summary (last 10 runs) [u]
  metrics_prom  Export: Prometheus metrics [m]
  metrics_json  Export: metrics JSON [j]
  export_json   Export: unified snapshot JSON [e]
  pack_logs     Support: guided support bundle wizard [p] [changes]
  back          Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, . previews, Enter browse, Esc back.
